purpose: Representative real-source validation for the Afghanistan Job Source Registry. This file records what was actually checked; unchecked sources remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED/unverified in docs/source_registry.json.
environment_notes: Arena fetch_page could retrieve public pages. Direct Python httpx/curl has previously returned TLS EOF for several external HTTPS hosts in this sandbox, so runtime network success is not over-claimed. Source adapters are failure-isolated and parser behavior is regression-tested with fixtures.
